name: 2026 FIFA World Cup Pool
description: A Rails 7 + Postgres pool app for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Players pick W/L/T for all 72 group games and fill out a full knockout bracket; admin enters results.

ADMIN_DISPLAY_NAME.description: Display name for initial admin account

APP_HOST.description: Public hostname used to build links in emails (e.g. password reset), e.g. your-app.herokuapp.com. Required for the reset-password email links to be correct.

MAILER_SENDER.description: From address on outgoing emails (password reset, etc.), e.g. no-reply@yourdomain.com.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key for /feed photo & video storage. Required because Heroku's file system is ephemeral (uploads on local disk are lost on each deploy/restart). Not needed if you provision the Bucketeer add-on, which sets its own BUCKETEER_* vars.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret access key (pairs with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID).

AWS_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for uploaded media.
